e-03.title: Go'aami waxa aad weydiin doonto ka hor jawaabta
e-03.goal: Go'aami macluumaadka aad runtii u baahan tahay ka hor intaadan ka jawaabin fariin martiqaad, oo qor jawaab gaaban oo Ingiriis ah oo weydiista.
e-03.material:
Waxaad heshay fariin ka timid saaxiibkaa Ari. "Let's play soccer tomorrow!"
Waxaad u malaynaysaa inay fiican tahay, laakiin fariintan keligeed ma ku filna in lagu go'aamiyo haddii aad tegi karto.
e-03.thinking.1: Dooro su'aalaha aad u baahan tahay
e-03.s.s1.prompt: Dooro wax kasta oo aad tahay inaad ogaato si aad uga jawaabto 'I can go.'
e-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi haddii jawaabta su'aal kasta horeba laga heli karo qoraalka.
e-03.s.s1.hint.1: Isku day su'aal kasta mid mid: haddii aadan haysan jawaabteeda, ma odhan kartaa 'I'll come'?
e-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakhtiga ayaa loo baahan yahay. Laakiin tan oo keliya, ma ogtid meesha aad tagayso. Hubi haddii wax kale loo baahan yahay.
e-03.s.s1.r.b: Goobta ayaa loo baahan yahay. Laakiin tan oo keliya, ma ogtid wakhtiga. Hubi haddii wax kale loo baahan yahay.
e-03.s.s1.r.c: Kubbad waa wax fiican in la haysto, laakiin looma baahna si loo go'aamiyo haddii aad tegi karto.
e-03.s.s1.r.d: Waxay caawin kartaa, laakiin waad go'aamin kartaa haddii aad tegi karto la'aanteed. Ka fikir haddii ay runtii tahay macluumaad lagama maarmaan ah.
e-03.s.s1.r.e: Ari ayaa horeba yiri let's play soccer. Tani waxay weydiisaa wax aad horeba taqaan.
e-03.s.s1.r.f: Ogaanshaha sababta waa wax fiican xiisaha, laakiin looma baahna si loo go'aamiyo haddii aad tegi karto. Su'aal lama huraan ma aha kaliya sababtoo ah waxay ku bilaabmaysaa ereyga su'aasha.
e-03.s.s1.explain: Haddii aadan aqoon wakhtiga iyo goobta, ma go'aamin kartid haddii ay ku habboon tahay jadwalkaaga ama haddii aad gaari karto. Haddii aad doortay mid oo keliya, mar kale tijaabi: kan kale la'aanteed, ma odhan kartaa 'I'll come'? (Haddii aad wakhtiga oo keliya taqaan, ma ogtid meesha aad tagayso; haddii aad goobta oo keliya taqaan, ma ogtid wakhtiga.)
e-03.s.s1.acc.0: Waa dabiici inaad rabto inaad ogaato cidda imanaysa sidoo kale. Laakiin qodobka ugu muhiimsan waa inaadan ka jawaabi karin wakhtiga iyo goobta la'aantood.
e-03.s.s2.prompt: Qor jawaab Ari Ingiriis ahaan. Muuji inaad rabto inaad ku biirto, oo ku dar su'aal weydiisanaysa macluumaadka aad kor ku doortay.
e-03.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore, qor weedh gaaban oo macnaheedu yahay 'Sounds good!'
e-03.s.s2.hint.1: Waxaad sidoo kale isku xiri kartaa labada su'aalood ee aad doortay hal weedh.
e-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka dib akhrinta jawaabtayda, ma sheegi karaa Ari wakhtiga iyo goobta?
e-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ka kooban tahay jawaab saaxiibtinimo iyo su'aalaha labadaba?
e-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waxaan weydiiyay anigoo isticmaalaya weedh ka dheer.

e-09.material:
Waxaad fariin ka heshay arday sannad ka hooseeya. Si aad u yar ayaad isu taqaaniin.

"Hi! Sorry to bother you, but could you look at my essay at some point? Thanks!!"

Waxaad rabtaa inaad caawiso, laakiin usbuucan waad mashquul tahay.
e-09.thinking.1: Mudnaan sii su'aalaha aad u baahan tahay
e-09.prereq.1: Hadallo edeb leh oo leh could / would
e-09.s.s1.prompt: Dooro wax kasta oo aad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato ka hor inta aadan jawaabin, si aad u go'aamiso inaad caawin karto iyo inaad si sax ah u caawiso.
e-09.s.s1.hint.0: Hoos u xariiq erayada aan cadayn ee fariinta, oo qor hal sadar mid kasta oo ku saabsan sababta eraygaas ka dhigayo go'aankaaga mid adag.
e-09.s.s1.hint.1: Isku day su'aal kasta mid mid: haddii aysan jawaab lahayn, ma odhan kartaa 'Haa, waan sameyn doonaa'?

e-09.s.s1.r.b: Nooca caawimada ayaa loo baahan yahay. Laakiin tan oo keliya kama ogaan kartid goorta ay tahay in la dhammeeyo. Hubi inay jirto su'aal kale oo aad u baahan tahay.
e-09.s.s1.r.c: Dhererka ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo qiyaaso waqtiga. Hubi in su'aalo kale sidoo kale loo baahan yahay.
e-09.s.s1.r.d: Darajooyinkii sannadkii hore si toos ah ugama xidhna inaad caawin karto qormadan, ama sida.
e-09.s.s1.r.e: Inay haystaan caawimo kale ma beddelo inaad caawin karto, ama sida.
e-09.s.s1.explain: 'At some point' waa mid aan cadayn goorta, 'look at'-na waa mid aan cadayn nooca caawimada. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato wakhtiga kama danbeysta, caawimada la rabo, iyo dhererka si aad u go'aamiso inaad waqti heli karto. Haddii aad doortay qaar oo keliya, tijaabi inaad caawin karto adigoo aan haysan jawaabta su'aal aad ka tagtay.
e-09.s.s1.acc.0: Wakhtiga kama danbeysta iyo nooca caawimada la rabo waa qodobbada muhiimka ah, dhererkuna waa wax aad ogaanayso kadib helitaanka, sidaas darteed ka tagistiisa waa macquul.
e-09.s.s1.acc.1: Sidoo kale waa macquul in marka hore lagu go'aamiyo wakhtiga kama danbeysta iyo dhererka inaad waqti heli karto, oo lagu weydiiyo nooca caawimada kadib.
e-09.s.s1.acc.2: Inkasta oo aad mashquul tahay usbuucan, marka hore waad qiyaasi kartaa inaad caawin karto nooca caawimada loo baahan yahay iyo dhererka. Laakiin dhawaan waxaad u baahan doontaa inaad ogaato wakhtiga kama danbeysta.
e-09.s.s2.prompt: Qor jawaab Ingiriis ah oo loo diro ardayga ka yar. Si edeb leh u muuji inaad diyaar u tahay inaad caawiso, oo ku dar ugu yaraan labada su'aalood ee aad doortay kor.
e-09.s.s2.hint.0: Go'aami laba su'aalood oo beddeli doona inaad caawin karto, ama sida.
e-09.s.s2.hint.1: Qor hal su'aal weedh kasta, oo dhig hadal ku saabsan caawinta bilowga.

e-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma codku waa sax qof aad si yar u taqaanid?
e-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Qaab ka edeb badan oo ka gaar badan.

e-10.title: Diidmo edeb leh, mise weli fursad ma jirtaa?
e-10.goal: Marka weedh kasta oo email edeb leh la muujiyo, dib u eeg xukunkaaga ku saabsan rabitaanka runta ah ee qofka kale, oo qor jawaab ku habboon.
e-10.material: Waxaad u dirtay qorshe samaynta beer khudradeed dugsiga Ms. Rowe, kaas oo mas'uul ka ah dugsiga. Email-ka jawaabta ayaa furmaya hal weedh mar kasta.
e-10.thinking.0: Qiyaas ujeedada ka danbeysa codka edebta ah
e-10.thinking.1: Dib u eeg xukun macluumaad cusub
e-10.prereq.1: Fahamka aasaasiga ah ee hadallada diidmada edebta ah
e-10.s.s1.prompt: Akhri email-ka hal qayb mar kasta, mar kasta dooro xukunkaaga ku saabsan in qorshaha la aqbali doono.
e-10.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore go'aami haddii weedha cusubi beddesho macnaha tan hore ama ay sii wadato.
e-10.s.s1.hint.1: Calaamadee erayada beddela socodka (But) iyo erayada gaarka ah sida taariikhaha iyo ujeedooyinka.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Waa maxay xukunka ugu macquulsan weedhdan oo keliya?
e-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Ammaan keligeed ma muujiyo go'aanka. Waxay noqon kartaa furitaanka diidmo jilicsan, ama salaan oo keliya. Weedha xigta ayaa muhiim ah.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waxay u badan tahay in la ansixiyo, iyadana dhawaan way noo sheegi doontaa.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Interesting' waa ammaan, laakiin ma aha eray go'aan ama ansixin ah.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Go'aanka weli ma ogaan karno, waxaana u baahannahay inaan aragno weedha xigta.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Hadalka xadka 'this year' wuu muhiim yahay. Haddii aad u akhriday 'diidmo edeb leh' tallaabada koowaad, weedhani waxay taageertaa akhrintaas, laakiin weli ma aha diidmo joogto ah.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Wuxuu leeyahay sannadkan way adag tahay, mana sheego wax wali kadib.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Macnaheedu waa diidmo buuxda hadda ka dib, sannadkan wax kale ha ahaadee.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wuxuu yidhi 'this year's budget' oo keliya. Waligiis ma sheegin diidmo joogto ah.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Waa dhibaato miisaaniyadeed oo keliya, sidaas darteed dhawaan ayaa la xallin doonaa oo waxaan bilaabi karnaa sannadkan.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wuxuu yidhi miisaaniyadda horey ayaa loo dejiyey.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Akhri ilaa weedha ugu dambeysa oo mar kale xukun.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Socodku wuxuu ku beddelmaa 'But', wakhtiga kama danbeysta (Friday), ujeedada (director), iyo waqtiga (March) waa kuwo gaar ah. Haddii aad u akhriday inaan wali la go'aamin ama inay rabto inay horay u socoto, haddii aad hore u go'aansatay 'diidmo edeb leh', waxaad u baahan tahay inaad dib u eegto xukunkaaga.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Waa edeb oo keliya, sidaas darteed looma baahna in la jawaabo.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Qof diidmo oo keliya rabaa ma bixiyo wakhti kama danbeys (Friday) iyo ujeedo (director, March) si faahfaahsan.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Weli ma go'aansan inay diidayso, macluumaadna way ururinaysaa si ay u xukunto.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Tani sidoo kale waa akhrin suurtagal ah. Laakiin 'I will show it to the director before the March budget meeting' wuxuu ka dhow yahay rabitaanka in horay loo socdo.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Waxay xiisaynaysaa, waxayna weydiisanaysaa agabka si loo horumariyo kulanka miisaaniyadda ee March.
e-10.s.s1.reflect: Sheeg sida xukunkaaga u beddelay tallaabada saddexaad kadib markaad xukuntay 'adag' tallaabada labaad. Erayadee (But, by Friday, before ... March) ayaa ahaa sababta?

e-10.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma iska ilaalisay inaad muujiso niyad-jab aad u badan?
e-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waxay u dan leedahay inay si edeb leh u diido.

e-01.title: Isku-darka laba xariiq oo ogeysiiska maktabadda si loo hubiyo qorshaha Ben
e-01.goal: Isku dar laba xariiq oo kala duwan oo ogeysiiska ah (jadwalka caadiga ah iyo ka-reebka toddobaadkan), maalin maalin ka go'aami haddii qorshaha saaxiibkaa uu shaqeynayo, oo u sheeg Ingiriis ahaan.
e-01.material:
Ogeysiiska albaabka maktabadda dugsiga (waxaa lagu qoray erayo oo keliya, sawir ma jiro):

Library
Open: Mon, Wed, Fri  3:00-4:00
This week: closed on Friday (cleaning day).

Saaxiibkaa Ben wuxuu yiri, "Let's go to the library on Thursday and on Friday this week!"
e-01.thinking.0: Isku dar dhowr xariiq oo ogeysiis ah si aad go'aan u gaarto
e-01.thinking.1: Hel caddayn gooni ah maalin kasta
e-01.s.s1.prompt: Miyuu Ben isticmaali karaa maktabadda Khamiista iyo Jimcaha toddobaadkan labadaba, sida uu qorsheeyay?
e-01.s.s1.hint.0: Eeg Khamiista iyo Jimcaha si gooni ah, oo is barbardhig waxa xariiq kasta oo ogeysiiska ah ay ka sheegayso maalintaas.
e-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi haddii xariiqda 'Open' iyo xariiqda 'This week' ay qabtaan hawlo kala duwan.
e-01.s.s1.r.a: Laga yaabaa inaadan akhrin labada xariiq ee ogeysiiska. Hubi haddii Khamiista ay ka mid tahay maalmaha furan, iyo haddii ay jirto qoraal gaar ah oo ku saabsan Jimcaha.
e-01.s.s1.r.c: Jimcaha badanaa wuu furan yahay, laakiin xariiqda 'This week' waxay sheegaysaa wax kale oo ku saabsan toddobaadkan.
e-01.s.s1.r.d: Mar kale eeg haddii Khamiista ay ku jirto liiska maalmaha furan (Open).
e-01.s.s1.explain: Khamiisto ma aha mid ka mid ah maalmaha furan (Mon, Wed, Fri), in kasta oo Jimcaha badanaa furan yahay, toddobaadkan waa 'closed on Friday'. Sidaas darteed midna maalintoodba ma shaqeyso.
e-01.s.s2.prompt: Dooro dhammaan xariiqyada aad u baahan tahay si aad u xukuntid qorshaha Ben (Khamiis iyo Jimce).
e-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isku day inaad tirtirto xariiq kasta oo aad aragto haddii ay noqonayso mid ka sii adag in la xukumo Khamiista ama Jimcaha.
e-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kala dhig erayada Ben iyo xariiqyada ogeysiiska.
e-01.s.s2.r.a: Tani waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu xukumo Khamiista, laakiin xariiqdan keligeed kuuma sheegayso Jimcaha toddobaadkan (badanaa waa furan yahay). Hubi haddii aad u baahan tahay xariiq kale sidoo kale.
e-01.s.s2.r.b: Tan waxaad u baahan tahay si aad u xukuntid Jimcaha, laakiin xariiqdan wax ma sheegto Khamiista. Hel xariiqda kuu oggolaanaysa inaad xukuntid Khamiista.
e-01.s.s2.r.c: Waa cinwaan oo keliya, sidaas darteed macluumaad ku saabsan maalmaha ma laha.
e-01.s.s2.r.d: Weedhdani waa soo jeedinta Ben. Soo jeedintu waa wax la hubiyo, ma aha caddayn.
e-01.s.s2.explain: Xariiqda Open waxay muujisaa in Khamiistu ayan ahayn maalin furan, xariiqda This week-na waxay muujisaa in Jimcuhu xidhan yahay toddobaadkan. Midkoodna keligiis ma xukumi karo labada maalmood. Haddii aad doortay mid oo keliya, hubi maalinta haray.
e-01.s.s3.prompt: Ka jawaab Ben Ingiriis ahaan hal ama laba weedhood. Sii sababta aadan Khamiista u tegi karin iyo sababta aadan Jimcaha u tegi karin.
e-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore, qor hal weedh oo u sheegaysa Ben 'maya, ma tegi karno.'
e-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qor hal weedh sababta Khamiista iyo hal weedh sababta Jimcaha, mid kasta oo ku xiran xariiq ogeysiiska.
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sii sabab Khamiista iyo sabab Jimcaha?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegi kartaa xariiqda ogeysiiska ee sabab kasta ka timid?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Haddii aad soo jeedisay maalin kale, ma hubisay inay runtii tahay maalin furan? (ikhtiyaari)
e-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Xitaa waxaan soo jeediyay maalin kale.

e-02.title: Hel weedhda jahwareersan ee fariinta martiqaadka
e-02.goal: Hel laba weedhood oo ku jira fariin martiqaad gaaban oo aan is waafaqsanayn, oo dib u qor si saaxiibadu u jahwareerin.
e-02.material: Tani waa fariin Jun u diray fasalladiisa. (Waxaa lagu qoray erayo oo keliya. Xariiq kasta waxay leedahay lambar.)
e-02.thinking.0: Hel macluumaad is diidaya weedhaha dhexdooda
e-02.thinking.1: Saadaali dhibaatada oo dib u qor
e-02.prereq.1: Falal fudud sida come / start the game
e-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal weedh oo laga yaabo inay jahwareerisay saaxiibada. Waa xariiq aan waafaqsanayn weedh kale.
e-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ururi xariiqyada ka kooban tirooyin (wakhtiyo) oo keliya.
e-02.s.s1.hint.1: Is barbardhig 'wakhtiga imaanshaha' iyo 'wakhtiga bilowga'. Kee ayaa hore u yimaadda?
e-02.s.s1.explain: Waxay u sheegtaa dadka inay yimaadaan 10, laakiin waxay tiraahdaa ciyaartu waxay bilaabmaysaa 9:30. Waad bedeli kartaa xariiqda 3 ama xariiqda 4. Xariiqda 1 (beerta Axadda) iyo xariiqda 2 (goobta beerta) lama khilaafsana xariiq kale. Haddii aad is barbardhigto xariiqyada leh tirooyin (wakhtiyo), waxaad arki kartaa khilaafka.
e-02.s.s2.prompt: Maxaa dhici kara haddii fariintan sidaas loo diro?
e-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qiyaas saaxiib helay fariinta oo eegaya saacadda oo sameynaya si sax ah waxa ay leedahay.
e-02.s.s2.hint.1: Is barbardhig: ma ciyaartii horeba way bilaabmatay marka saaxiibkaasi yimid?
e-02.s.s2.o.a: Saaxiib imaanaya 10 wuxuu seegaa ciyaar horeba u bilaabantay.
e-02.s.s2.o.b: Saaxiib imaanaya 9:30 wuxuu sugayaa beer madhan ka hor inta ciyaartu bilaabmin.
e-02.s.s2.r.b: Tani runtii way ku dhici kartaa saaxiib rumaysan bilowga 9:30 oo halkaas yimaada. Laakiin dhibaatada ugu toosan ee ay keento khilaafka 'come at 10' waa a.
e-02.s.s2.o.c: Saaxiibadu way imanayaan Sabti halkii Axad.
e-02.s.s2.r.c: Maalinta si cad ayaa loo yidhi Axad. Dhibaatadu waa wakhtiga.
e-02.s.s2.explain: Dhibaatadu waxay ku xiran tahay midka labada wakhti aad raacdo. Haddii aad raacdo 10, waxaad seegaysaa ciyaarta (a); haddii aad raacdo 9:30, waad jahwareersan tahay sababtoo ah way ka duwan tahay waxa xariiqda kale ay sheegayso (b). Siyaabaha oo dhan, way dhacdaa sababtoo ah labada wakhti isma waafaqsana.

e-07.title: Isku dar laba ogeysiis si aad u xisaabiso wakhtiga bas-ka ka baxaya
e-07.goal: Isku dar laba ogeysiis oo taariikho kala duwan lagu dhejiyay (wakhtigii asalka ahaa iyo isbeddel dambe) si aad u xisaabiso wakhtiga cusub ee ka bixitaanka, oo ku saxo fahamka khaldan ee saaxiib adigoo isticmaalaya caddayn.
e-07.material:
Laba ogeysiis ayaa lagu dhejiyay looxa ogeysiisyada ee safka basaska. (Waxaa lagu qoray erayo oo keliya.)

Notice A (posted on Monday): "Bus 5 leaves at 7:40 a.m."
Notice B (posted on Wednesday): "From Thursday, Bus 5 will leave 10 minutes earlier. Please be at the stop on time."

Saaxiibkaa Hana: "Bus 5 leaves at 7:50 on Thursday."
Saaxiibkaa Jae: "Then on Friday it leaves at the same time as on Thursday."
e-07.thinking.0: Isku dar dhawr xog si aad gabagabo u gaadho
e-07.thinking.1: Fahan sida ogeysiis dambe u beddelo mid hore
e-07.prereq.0: Hadallada sida earlier / later / from + maalin
e-07.s.s1.prompt: Marka laga fiiriyo labada ogeysiis, Hana ma sax baa?
e-07.s.s1.hint.0: Is barbar dhig taariikhaha labada ogeysiis la dhejiyay. Kee ayaa ka dambeeya?
e-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi in earlier macnaheedu yahay 'goor hore' mise 'goor dambe', oo ka xisaabi 7:40.

e-07.s.s2.prompt: Jae wuxuu yiri, "On Friday it's the same time as Thursday." Sidee ayaad ku xukumi kartaa hadalkan ogeysiisyada?

e-08.s.s1.explain: Taariikhda, wakhtiga, iyo goobtu dhammaantood waa madmadow sababta 'or' awgeed, waxa la keenayana waa madmadow maxaa yeelay ma ogaan kartid waxa 'something' yahay. Haddii aad dooratay qaar oo keliya, mar kale tijaabi in akhriyuhu ku shaqayn karo hal shay oo keliya walxaha aad ka tagtay.
e-08.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor ogeysiiska isla kulankaas Ingiriis iyada oo aan jirin fahan khaldan. Go'aami oo qor maalinta, wakhtiga, goobta, iyo waxa la keenayo.
e-08.s.s2.hint.0: Maskaxdaada gudaheeda, samee miis aad ku hagaajisid hal shay maalin, wakhti, goob, iyo waxa la keenayo mid kasta.
e-08.s.s2.hint.1: Male-awaal in saaxiib aan weligii kulanka tagin uu ku heli karo ogeysiiskan oo keliya.
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ogeysiiskaagu ma leeyahay qayb aad ku dhigtay laba doorasho adigoo isticmaalaya 'or'? (Tusaale ahaan, laba wakhti ama laba goob)
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Xitaa saaxiib markii ugu horreysay arkaya, ma ogaan karaa meesha uu aadayo?
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Taariikhda (maalinta) iyo waqtiga labaduba ma lagu go'aamiyey hal shay?
e-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Cod saaxiibtinimo leh. Erayga 'or' ee waxa la keenayo waa doorasho oo keliya, ma aha mid aan caddayn.

e-11.title: Baarista sheegashada 'Dhibcuhu way hoos u dheceen, sidaas darteed waa khaladka Wi-Fi'
e-11.goal: Qiimee in sababaynta sabab-saameyn ee warqad wargeyska dugsigu ku filan tahay, go'aami macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si loo hubiyo sheegashada, oo si edeb leh u qor gaddoon Ingiriis ah oo loo diro qoraaga.
e-11.material:
Warqad akhriste ah oo ku jirta wargeyska dugsiga (qoraal male-awaal ah):

"Last year, our school's average English score was 78. This year, after the school started free Wi-Fi, it fell to 72. So the Wi-Fi caused the drop. Therefore we should turn the Wi-Fi off."
e-11.thinking.1: Dooro macluumaadka loo baahan yahay hubinta
e-11.prereq.0: Hadallo sabab-saameyn sida therefore / so / caused
e-11.prereq.1: Ku khilaafidda si edeb leh (I see your point, however ...)
e-11.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal weedh qoraalkan ah oo ku hadlaya sida haddii ay tahay xaqiiqo hubaal ah inkasta oo cadayntu ka maqan tahay.
e-11.s.s1.hint.0: U kala saar sadar kasta 'wax dhacay' ama 'sheegasho ku saabsan sabab ama waxa la sameyn lahaa.'
e-11.s.s1.hint.1: Tijaabi in sadarrada sheegashada ay ka soo raacaan sadarrada xaqiiqada ee ka horreeya oo keliya.
e-11.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 3 ('So the Wi-Fi caused the drop.') wuxuu ka booday 'wuu dhacay kadib' ilaa 'waa sababta.' 'we should turn it off' ee sadarka 4 sidoo kale cadayn ma leh, laakiin wuxuu ku tiirsan yahay boodka sadarka 3. Sadarrada 1 iyo 2 waa hadallo xaqiiqo ah oo ku saabsan dhibcaha iyo waqtiga.
e-11.s.s2.prompt: Macluumaadkee ayaa kaa caawin lahaa inaad hubiso 'The Wi-Fi is the cause of the score drop'? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
e-11.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir laba sababood oo aan ahayn Wi-Fi oo dhibcuhu u beddeli karaan.
e-11.s.s2.hint.1: Xukun in doorasho kasta ay caawin karto kala saarida in Wi-Fi ama sabab kale ay tahay sababta.
e-11.s.s2.o.a: Sida dhibcaha Ingiriisku u beddeleen isla sannadka dugsi kale oo aan lahayn Wi-Fi
e-11.s.s2.r.a: Is barbar dhig waa hab wanaagsan. Sidoo kale eeg inaad hubin karto farqiyada adkaanta imtixaanka ama kooxda ardayda.
e-11.s.s2.o.b: Inuu imtixaanka Ingiriisiga ee sannadkan ka adkaa kii sannadkii hore
e-11.s.s2.r.b: Haddii imtixaanka la beddelay, waa sabab muhiim ah. Sidoo kale eeg is barbar dhigga dugsiyada kale iyo kooxda ardayda.
e-11.s.s2.o.c: Imisa arday ayaa jecel fasalka Ingiriisiga
e-11.s.s2.r.c: Intee ardaydu jecel yihiin fasalku wuxuu la xidhiidhi karaa dhibcaha, laakiin ma kala saari karo in Wi-Fi uu yahay sababta.
e-11.s.s2.o.d: Intee ay ku kacday rakibaadda Wi-Fi
e-11.s.s2.r.d: Kharashku wuxuu la xidhiidhaa go'aanka rakibidda, laakiin wax ku saabsan ma laha sababta dhibcuhu hoos ugu dhaceen.
e-11.s.s2.o.e: Inay ardaydu runtii isticmaaleen taleefannadooda inta lagu jiray fasalka Ingiriisiga
e-11.s.s2.r.e: Tani waa macluumaad hubiya jidka. Sidoo kale eeg sababaha kale (imtixaanka, kooxda ardayda, dugsiyada kale).
e-11.s.s2.o.f: Inay ardayda sannadkan tahay koox ka duwan ardaydii sannadkii hore (xirfado, qadarka waxbarasho, iwm.)
e-11.s.s2.explain: Is barbar dhigidda dugsiyada kale (a), hubinta adkaanta imtixaanka (b), iyo hubinta inay runtii la isticmaalay inta lagu jiray fasalka (e) iyo farqiyada kooxda ardayda (f) waxay kuu oggolaadaan inaad kala saarto in Wi-Fi ama sabab kale ay tahay sababta. Tirada ardayda jecel fasalka iyo kharashka rakibaadda si toos ah uma xidhna sababta.
e-11.s.s2.acc.0: Is barbar dhigidda dugsiyada kale iyo hubinta adkaanta imtixaanka keliya horey ayay u filan yihiin inay caawiyaan kala saarida sababaha kale.
e-11.s.s2.acc.1: Haddii aad sidoo kale hubiso inay runtii la isticmaalay inta lagu jiray fasalka, waxaad arki kartaa jidka uu Wi-Fi ku shaqayn karay.
e-11.s.s2.acc.2: Farqiyada kooxda ardayda sidoo kale waa sabab kale oo caadi ah oo ka dambeysa isbeddelka dhibcaha.
e-11.s.s3.prompt: Qor gaddoon 2-3 weedhood ah oo Ingiriis ah oo loo diro qoraaga. Aqbal xaqiiqada ah in dhibcuhu hoos u dheceen, laakiin sharax in sheegashada ah Wi-Fi waa sababta aysan weli ku filnayn, oo bixi hal hab oo lagu hubiyo ama hal sabab kale.
e-11.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore, hal weedh ku qiraal qaybta qoraagu sax ahaa (dhibcuhu hoos u dheceen).
e-11.s.s3.hint.1: Kadib qor hal sabab gaar ah oo ay uga filnayn tahay in loogu yeedho 'sababta' (sabab kale ama is barbar dhig).
e-11.s.s3.placeholder: Tusaale: I see your point, but ...
e-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qorigaagu wuxuu aqbalay xaqiiqada ah in dhibcuhu hoos u dheceen?
e-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma bixisay hal sabab oo ay uga filnayn tahay in si adag loogu sheego 'sababta'?
e-11.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma codku waa mid tilmaama macquulnimada adigoon weerarin qoraaga?
e-11.s.s3.modelNote.1: Weedh ka dheer, ka akadeemi badan.

e-12.title: Marka 'It's fine.' aysan fiicnayn: abuurista wada hadal
e-12.goal: Xukun in hadallo sida 'It's fine.' laga yaabo inaysan ka dhigan macnaha dhabta ah, oo abuur wada hadal Ingiriis ah oo gaaban oo ku saabsan xaalad caynkaas ah si loo buuxiyo shuruudaha.
e-12.material: A ayaa ku tidhi B, "I'm sorry I forgot to call you last night." B waxay tan ku jawaabi karaan dhawr hab. (Waxaa lagu qoray erayo oo keliya.)
e-12.thinking.0: Qiyaas ujeedada qarsoon ee ka timaadda cod iyo macnaha guud
e-12.prereq.1: Hadallo sida Are you sure? / You sound ...
e-12.s.s1.prompt: Jawaabaha B dhexdooda, kee ayaa ugu badan in lagu iska dhigayo fiicnaan marka runtii aysan fiicnayn?
e-12.s.s1.hint.0: Akhri jawaab kasta cod dheer, oo qiyaas in qof runtii fiican sidaas u odhan lahaa.
e-12.s.s1.hint.1: Is barbar dhig in jawaab kasta ka kooban tahay 'sabab uu fiicanyahay' ama 'wax la rabo', ama in kuwaasi maqan yihiin.
e-12.s.s1.r.a: Hadalku waa mid caadi ah oo sabab leh. Sababta ahaanshaha fiican waxay ku jirtaa weedha.
e-12.s.s1.r.c: Waxay noqon kartaa mid aan habboonayn sababtoo ah si xoog leh ayaa loo yidhi, laakiin way adagtahay in dareenka laga xukumo weedha oo keliya.
e-12.s.s1.r.d: Waxaa la yidhi waa fiican yahay, laakiin sidoo kale waxaa la sheegay waxa la rabo. Wax yar ayaa la qariyey.
e-12.s.s1.explain: Haddii 'It's fine.' gaaban oo caadi ah oo keliya la yidhaahdo, sabab iyo dareen midna ma muuqdaan, sidaas darteed si fudud ayaa loo akhriyaa sida dareenka gudaha oo la qarinayo. Laakiin ma hubi kartid weedha oo keliya, waana inaad isla markiiba eegtaa cod iyo macnaha guud.
e-12.s.s1.acc.0: 'totally' oo si xad dhaaf ah loo xoojiyey wuxuu runtii noqon karaa calaamad ah in la qarinayo inaan fiicnayn.
e-12.s.s1.acc.1: Hakadka 'Just...' waa calaamad ah in dhammaan wax aysan fiicnayn. Laakiin waa ka yar suurtagal, maadaama qayb ka mid ah dareenka la sheegayo.
e-12.s.s2.prompt:
Abuur wada hadal Ingiriis ah oo buuxiya shuruudaha hoose. Ku bilow sadar kasta A: ama B:, oo qor ugu yaraan 4 sadar.
Shuruudda 1) B ayaa erayo sida 'fine' ama 'okay' ku sheegta in wax kasta fiican yihiin, laakiin runtii waxaa u muuqda cadho.
Shuruudda 2) A ayaa dareenta tan oo si jilicsan u weydiisa (isticmaal calaamad su'aal).
Shuruudda 3) Dhammaadka, B ayaa sheegta wax yar oo ah sida runtii loo dareemayo.
e-12.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore dooro hal xaalad (ilaawid ballan, hadiyad, natiijada imtixaan, iwm.).
e-12.s.s2.hint.1: Ka dhig jawaabta koowaad ee B mid gaaban, oo ku bilow su'aasha A si kooban, sida 'Are you sure?'
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma dareemi kartaa wada hadalka inay erayada B ('fine') iyo dareenka runta ah ee B kala duwan yihiin? Sadarkee?
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma su'aasha A waa jilicsan tahay, ma aha eedeyn?
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Sadarka ugu dambeeya, ma B ayaa sheegtay wax yar oo ah sida runtii loo dareemayo?
e-12.s.s2.modelNote.0: Socod halkaas oo dareenka runta ah uu ka muuqdo xaalad cafis ah.
e-12.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wada hadal buuxiya isla shuruudaha leh xaalad kale.
